heading: Welcome to the Solar Deployment Explorer
body: See how much solar power countries really have.

spotlightCaption: Switch between installed capacity, capacity per person, and how much of a country's electricity comes from solar.
Click a country on the map, search for one, or pick from this list to see its own numbers and history.
See its installed capacity, its share of electricity, and the population used for the per-person view - plus links to see it in the other GSC tools.
